questions.question: Which of these players went on to be a match referee in a women's test match?
questions.explanation: Fritz was the match referee in the test match between South Africa and England, December 2024.

questions.question: At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 90, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: At which ground did Marlene Steenkamp record their career-best innings (90*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Knights on 2013/11/09.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
Who holds the record for 'Most 5-Wicket Hauls' in the 22/23 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Ricea Coetzer holds it, with a total of 2.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)' in the 19/20 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Jana Nell holds it, with a total of 27.
